slides.title: Family Time
bullets: Prepare to read, discuss and write
slides.narration: Welcome to Grade 1 English, Unit 2: Family Time. In this unit you will learn the words for the people in your family — mum, dad, sister, brother, grandma and grandpa. You will also learn some breakfast and fruit words, and how to count from 1 to 10. You will talk about who is in your family, and about how families help each other and have fun together. Say the words out loud — this is about talking with confidence, not perfect spelling. In this short lecture, preview the key ideas and prepare for the independent lesson.

slides.title: What you will achieve
bullets: Name the people in a family (mother, father, sister, brother, grandma, grandpa, baby).
Name some breakfast foods and fruits (pancakes, cereal, milk, mango, banana, grapes).
Count from 1 to 10, and count backwards from 10 to 1.
slides.narration: By the end of this unit, you will be able to name the people in a family (mother, father, sister, brother, grandma, grandpa, baby). You will also name some breakfast foods and fruits (pancakes, cereal, milk, mango, banana, grapes). You will also count from 1 to 10, and count backwards from 10 to 1. Keep these goals in mind as you work.

slides.title: Words to learn
slides.narration: Your vocabulary work begins with these words: egg, hen, bed, pen, wet, ten. Listen to each word, look at what it means, and try to use it when you talk and write.

slides.title: Read and think
bullets: Point to the words that show it
slides.narration: The reading sequence includes Breakfast at Grandma's House and Talk about Family Time. Read slowly, look at the pictures, and find the big idea in each text. When you answer a question, point to the words that show it.

slides.title: Introduce a family member
bullets: Show a family photo or drawing and say who it is. The word 'my' shows they belong to your family.
Try it in your own sentences
slides.narration: The first language focus is Introduce a family member. Show a family photo or drawing and say who it is. The word 'my' shows they belong to your family. Look at the examples, then try the pattern in your own sentences.

slides.title: Use English for a real purpose
bullets: Say it, write it, make it better
slides.narration: In speaking, you will complete Speaking 1 - Listen and point. Say your ideas clearly and listen to your partner. In writing, you will draw, trace, copy or write, then check your work with a grown-up or the AI tutor.

slides.title: You are ready to begin
bullets: Activities, quiz and optional live sessions
slides.narration: You are ready to begin. Start with the words, then the reading and the questions, then the grammar, speaking and writing. Ask the AI tutor for help any time, and bring your questions to a live session too if you join one.
